moment_title: Remembering the campaign to turn railway land into a path
body: The Prairie Path history traces the campaign to May Watts’s 1963 letter and the work of many volunteers. Founders Park provides a later place to interpret that effort. The newsletter and City locate the park along Liberty Drive. This mapped trail point lies within that described area; it is not asserted to be the exact memorial boulder or the place where the campaign’s events occurred.
